extends "res://scripts/screen3d.gd"
## BLITZ: marathon of 3D micro-games against the GRAYLORD.

const MICROS := {
	"smash": preload("res://scripts/micro/smash.gd"),
	"dodge": preload("res://scripts/micro/dodge.gd"),
	"blast": preload("res://scripts/micro/blast.gd"),
	"jump": preload("res://scripts/micro/jump.gd"),
	"defuse": preload("res://scripts/micro/defuse.gd"),
	"goal": preload("res://scripts/micro/goal.gd"),
	"stack": preload("res://scripts/micro/stack.gd"),
	"launch": preload("res://scripts/micro/launch.gd"),
	"hack": preload("res://scripts/micro/hack.gd"),
	"drift": preload("res://scripts/micro/drift.gd"),
	"bowl": preload("res://scripts/micro/bowl.gd"),
	"catch": preload("res://scripts/micro/catch.gd"),
}
const BOSS := preload("res://scripts/micro/boss.gd")
const BOSS_EVERY := 10
const WIN_LINES := ["Impossible. Again.", "You got lucky.", "Your fun ends here.", "Stop. Having. Fun.", "I will make you yawn.", "Enjoy it while it lasts."]
const LOSE_LINES := ["Boredom wins.", "Pathetic.", "Yawn.", "Too slow, human.", "Gray is the future."]

var hub: Node3D
var hub_cam: Camera3D
var drone: Node3D
var lord: Node3D
var phase := "inter"
var pt := 0.0
var lives := 4
var score := 0
var speed := 1.0
var level := 1
var since_boss := 0
var pool: Array = []
var micro: Node3D = null
var last := 0
var lord_line := "So you think you can beat boredom?"
var banner := ""
var banner_sub := ""
var paused := false
var new_best := false
var lost_life := -1
var xp_gain := 0
var rank_up := false
var pause_btn: Dictionary
var b_resume: Dictionary
var b_quit: Dictionary
var b_again: Dictionary
var b_menu: Dictionary
var is_boss := false
var tick_last := -1
var cleared_since_speed := 0


func setup() -> void:
	hub = Node3D.new()
	add_child(hub)
	hub_cam = Camera3D.new()
	hub_cam.fov = 55
	hub.add_child(hub_cam)
	K.env(hub, "night", hub_cam)
	K.ground(hub, 300.0, G.MAGENTA, Color(0.03, 0.015, 0.04), 3.0, 2.0)
	K.city(hub, Vector3.ZERO, 30.0, 130.0, 200, 17)
	var plat := K.cyl(hub, 4.5, 4.9, 0.6, Vector3(0, 0.3, 0), K.mat(Color("181b28"), 0.85, 0.3), 6)
	plat.rotation_degrees.y = 30
	K.torus(hub, 4.55, 4.75, Vector3(0, 0.62, 0), K.neon(G.CYAN, 4.0), 6).rotation_degrees.y = 30
	drone = K.drone(hub, G.CYAN)
	drone.position = Vector3(0, 2.4, 0)
	drone.scale = Vector3.ONE * 1.6
	lord = K.graylord(hub, 2.6)
	lord.position = Vector3(26, 15, -46)
	cam = hub_cam
	pause_btn = add_button("", G.WHITE, toggle_pause, 40, "pause")
	b_resume = add_button("RESUME", G.LIME, toggle_pause, 46)
	b_quit = add_button("QUIT", G.RED, func(): G.main.go("title"), 46)
	b_again = add_button("RETRY", G.LIME, func(): G.main.go("blitz", arg), 46)
	b_menu = add_button("MENU", G.CYAN, func(): G.main.go("title"), 46)
	for b in [b_resume, b_quit, b_again, b_menu]:
		b.visible = false
	if arg is Dictionary and arg.has("speed"):
		speed = arg.speed
	G.play_music("blitz", speed)
	pt = -0.5
	if arg is Dictionary and arg.has("only"):
		pt = 10.0


func layout() -> void:
	pause_btn.rect = Rect2(Vector2(W - 110 * U, 22 * U), Vector2(88, 88) * U)
	var bw := 340 * U
	var bh := 100 * U
	b_resume.rect = Rect2(W * 0.5 - bw * 0.5, H * 0.5 - 30 * U, bw, bh)
	b_quit.rect = Rect2(W * 0.5 - bw * 0.5, H * 0.5 + 100 * U, bw, bh)
	if portrait:
		b_again.rect = Rect2(W * 0.5 - bw * 0.5, H - 290 * U, bw, bh)
		b_menu.rect = Rect2(W * 0.5 - bw * 0.5, H - 170 * U, bw, bh)
	else:
		b_again.rect = Rect2(W * 0.5 - bw - 16 * U, H - 150 * U, bw, bh)
		b_menu.rect = Rect2(W * 0.5 + 16 * U, H - 150 * U, bw, bh)
	if micro:
		micro.queue_free()
		micro = null
		hub.visible = true
		hub_cam.make_current()
		if phase in ["prompt", "play", "result"]:
			phase = "inter"
			pt = 0.0


func toggle_pause() -> void:
	if phase == "over":
		return
	paused = not paused
	b_resume.visible = paused
	b_quit.visible = paused
	G.music_player.stream_paused = paused
	get_tree().paused = false


func next_id() -> String:
	if arg is Dictionary and arg.has("only") and MICROS.has(arg.only):
		return arg.only
	if pool.is_empty():
		pool = MICROS.keys()
		pool.shuffle()
	return pool.pop_back()


func inter_len() -> float:
	return (2.4 if last == 0 else 1.5) / speed


func update(dt: float) -> void:
	if paused:
		return
	pt += dt
	# hub animation
	if hub.visible:
		drone.position.y = 2.4 + sin(T * 1.8) * 0.15
		drone.rotation.y = sin(T * 0.6) * 0.6
		K.spin_rotors(drone, dt)
		lord.rotation.y = sin(T * 0.3) * 0.5
		lord.position.y = 15 + sin(T * 0.8) * 0.8
		var rings: Array = lord.get_meta("rings")
		(rings[0] as Node3D).rotate_object_local(Vector3.UP, dt * 0.9)
		(rings[1] as Node3D).rotate_object_local(Vector3.UP, -dt * 0.6)
		var a := T * 0.12
		hub_cam.position = Vector3(sin(a) * 3.0, 3.6, 10.5 + cos(a) * 1.0)
		hub_cam.look_at(Vector3(2.0, 4.2, -10), Vector3.UP)
	match phase:
		"inter":
			if pt >= inter_len():
				var boss_only: bool = arg is Dictionary and arg.get("only", "") == "boss"
				if since_boss >= BOSS_EVERY or boss_only:
					show_banner("BOSS FIGHT", "The GRAYLORD attacks!", "boss")
				elif cleared_since_speed >= 5 and speed < 1.85:
					cleared_since_speed = 0
					show_banner("SPEED UP", "", "speedup")
					speed = minf(1.9, speed + 0.12)
					G.set_music_pitch(speed)
				else:
					start_micro(false)
		"banner":
			if pt >= 1.6:
				start_micro(banner == "BOSS FIGHT")
		"prompt":
			micro.step(0.0)
			if pt >= 1.15 / sqrt(speed):
				phase = "play"
				pt = 0.0
		"play":
			micro.step(dt * speed)
			var left: float = micro.dur - micro.t
			var sec := int(ceil(left))
			if sec <= 3 and sec != tick_last and micro.result == 0:
				tick_last = sec
				G.play("tick" if sec % 2 == 1 else "tock", 1.0, -6.0)
			if micro.result != 0:
				phase = "result"
				pt = 0.0
				G.play("win" if micro.result > 0 else "lose", 1.0, -2.0)
			elif micro.t >= micro.dur:
				micro.timeout()
				phase = "result"
				pt = 0.0
				G.play("win" if micro.result > 0 else "lose", 1.0, -2.0)
		"result":
			micro.step(dt * speed)
			if pt >= (2.2 if is_boss else 1.0):
				finish(micro.result)


func show_banner(s: String, sub: String, snd: String) -> void:
	banner = s
	banner_sub = sub
	phase = "banner"
	pt = 0.0
	G.play(snd)
	shake(0.5)


func start_micro(boss: bool) -> void:
	is_boss = boss
	var scr: GDScript = BOSS if boss else MICROS[next_id()]
	micro = scr.new()
	add_child(micro)
	micro.init(W, H, level)
	micro.cam.make_current()
	hub.visible = false
	phase = "prompt"
	pt = 0.0
	tick_last = -1
	G.play("whoosh", 1.0, -4.0)


func finish(res: int) -> void:
	micro.queue_free()
	micro = null
	hub.visible = true
	hub_cam.make_current()
	last = res
	lost_life = -1
	if res > 0:
		score += 1
		cleared_since_speed += 1
		G.data.won = int(G.data.won) + 1
		since_boss += 1
		var gain := 10 + level * 5
		if is_boss:
			since_boss = 0
			level = mini(3, level + 1)
			G.data.boss_wins = int(G.data.boss_wins) + 1
			gain = 100
			lord_line = "This is not over. I will return... STRONGER."
			G.play("fanfare")
			fx.shards(Vector2(W * 0.5, H * 0.6), 80, 1100 * U)
		else:
			lord_line = WIN_LINES[randi() % WIN_LINES.size()]
		xp_gain += gain
		if G.add_xp(gain):
			rank_up = true
			fx.text(Vector2(W * 0.5, H * 0.55), "RANK UP: " + G.rank_name(), G.YELLOW, 60 * U)
			G.play("fanfare")
	else:
		lives -= 1
		lost_life = lives
		if is_boss:
			since_boss = 0
		lord_line = LOSE_LINES[randi() % LOSE_LINES.size()]
		shake(0.6)
	is_boss = false
	if lives <= 0:
		game_over()
		return
	phase = "inter"
	pt = 0.0


func game_over() -> void:
	phase = "over"
	pt = 0.0
	pause_btn.visible = false
	G.data.runs = int(G.data.runs) + 1
	new_best = score > int(G.data.best)
	if new_best:
		G.data.best = score
	G.save_game()
	G.stop_music()
	b_again.visible = true
	b_menu.visible = true
	lord_line = "BOREDOM WINS. Come back when you dare."
	if new_best and score > 0:
		G.play("fanfare")
		fx.rain(W, 120)
	else:
		G.play("lose")


func down(p: Vector2, i: int) -> void:
	if phase == "play" and not paused and micro:
		micro.down(p, i)


func drag(p: Vector2, i: int, rel: Vector2) -> void:
	if phase in ["play", "result"] and not paused and micro:
		micro.drag(p, i, rel)


func up(p: Vector2, i: int) -> void:
	if micro and not paused and phase in ["play", "result"]:
		micro.up(p, i)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ HUD
func paint() -> void:
	if micro and phase in ["prompt", "play", "result"]:
		micro.paint2d(hud)
		micro.fx.draw(hud)
	if phase in ["inter", "banner"]:
		draw_hub()
	elif phase == "over":
		draw_over()


func draw_cells(c: Vector2) -> void:
	var gap := 92.0 * U
	for k in 4:
		var p := c + Vector2((k - 1.5) * gap, 0)
		var alive := k < lives
		var just := k == lost_life and phase == "inter" and pt < 0.7
		if just:
			p += Vector2(randf_range(-1, 1), randf_range(-1, 1)) * 8 * U
		var r := Rect2(p - Vector2(30, 44) * U, Vector2(60, 88) * U)
		G.chamfer(hud, r, 10 * U, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.5), Color(G.CYAN, 0.9) if alive else Color(1, 1, 1, 0.25), 3 * U)
		hud.draw_rect(Rect2(p - Vector2(12, 52) * U, Vector2(24, 8) * U), Color(G.CYAN, 0.9) if alive else Color(1, 1, 1, 0.25))
		if alive:
			var f := 0.75 + 0.25 * sin(T * 4.0 + k)
			G.chamfer(hud, r.grow(-8 * U), 6 * U, Color(G.CYAN, 0.5 + 0.3 * f))
		elif just:
			G.chamfer(hud, r.grow(-8 * U), 6 * U, Color(G.RED, 0.8 * (1.0 - pt / 0.7)))


func draw_hub() -> void:
	var top := 120.0 * U
	G.txt(hud, Vector2(W * 0.5, top), str(score), int(140 * U), G.WHITE, 0, G.font_title, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, G.INK, 1.0)
	G.txt(hud, Vector2(W * 0.5, top + 92 * U), "STREAK", int(26 * U), G.CYAN, 0, G.font_body)
	draw_cells(Vector2(W * 0.5, top + 190 * U))
	var left := BOSS_EVERY - since_boss
	if left <= 3 and left > 0:
		G.txt(hud, Vector2(W * 0.5, top + 285 * U), "BOSS IN %d" % left, int(32 * U), G.RED, 0, G.font_title, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, G.INK, 1.0)
	# villain comm panel
	var r := Rect2(W * 0.5 - 340 * U, H - 170 * U, 680 * U, 110 * U)
	G.chamfer(hud, r, 18 * U, G.PANEL, Color(G.RED, 0.7), 2 * U)
	G.txt(hud, r.position + Vector2(24 * U, 26 * U), "GRAYLORD //", int(20 * U), G.RED, 0, G.font_title, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT)
	var shown := lord_line.substr(0, int(pt * 40.0))
	G.txt(hud, r.position + Vector2(24 * U, 70 * U), shown, int(30 * U), G.WHITE, 0, G.font_bold, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT)
	if speed > 1.01:
		G.txt(hud, Vector2(40 * U, 60 * U), "SPEED x%.1f" % speed, int(26 * U), G.YELLOW, 0, G.font_title, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT)


func draw_over() -> void:
	hud.draw_rect(Rect2(0, 0, W, H), Color(G.INK, 0.45))
	var top := 110.0 * U
	G.txt(hud, Vector2(W * 0.5, top), "GAME OVER", int(100 * U), G.RED, 0, G.font_title, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, G.INK, 1.2)
	G.txt(hud, Vector2(W * 0.5, top + 110 * U), "STREAK  %d" % score, int(52 * U), G.WHITE, 0)
	if new_best and score > 0:
		var s := 1.0 + sin(T * 8.0) * 0.05
		G.txt(hud, Vector2(W * 0.5, top + 180 * U), "NEW RECORD!", int(48 * U * s), G.YELLOW, 0, G.font_title, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, G.INK, 1.0)
	else:
		G.txt(hud, Vector2(W * 0.5, top + 180 * U), "BEST  %d" % int(G.data.best), int(36 * U), G.YELLOW, 0)
	var r := Rect2(W * 0.5 - 280 * U, top + 230 * U, 560 * U, 120 * U)
	G.chamfer(hud, r, 18 * U, G.PANEL, Color(G.CYAN, 0.6), 2 * U)
	G.txt(hud, r.position + Vector2(24 * U, 30 * U), "+%d XP" % xp_gain, int(32 * U), G.LIME, 0, G.font_title, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT)
	G.txt(hud, r.end - Vector2(24 * U, 90 * U), G.rank_name(), int(32 * U), G.YELLOW, 0, G.font_title, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT)
	G.bar(hud, Rect2(r.position + Vector2(24 * U, 64 * U), Vector2(r.size.x - 48 * U, 18 * U)), G.rank_progress(), G.CYAN)
	G.txt(hud, r.position + Vector2(24 * U, 100 * U), "%d / %d XP" % [int(G.data.xp), G.next_rank_xp()], int(20 * U), G.WHITE, 0, G.font_body, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT)


func paint_top() -> void:
	if phase == "banner":
		var k := minf(1.0, pt * 4.0)
		var sc := 1.0 + (1.0 - k) * 1.5
		var col := G.RED if banner == "BOSS FIGHT" else G.YELLOW
		hud.draw_rect(Rect2(0, H * 0.5 - 120 * U, W, 240 * U), Color(G.INK, 0.8))
		hud.draw_rect(Rect2(0, H * 0.5 - 120 * U, W, 4 * U), col)
		hud.draw_rect(Rect2(0, H * 0.5 + 116 * U, W, 4 * U), col)
		var gl := Vector2(randf_range(-6, 6), 0) * U if pt < 0.4 else Vector2.ZERO
		G.txt(hud, Vector2(W * 0.5, H * 0.5 - 15 * U) + gl, banner, int(120 * U * sc), col, 0, G.font_title, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, G.INK, 1.2)
		if banner_sub != "":
			G.txt(hud, Vector2(W * 0.5, H * 0.5 + 75 * U), banner_sub, int(34 * U), G.WHITE, 0, G.font_bold)
	if micro and phase in ["prompt", "play", "result"]:
		var acc: Color = micro.accent
		if phase == "prompt":
			var k := minf(1.0, pt * 5.0)
			var sc := 1.0 + (1.0 - k) * 1.4
			hud.draw_rect(Rect2(0, 0, W, H), Color(G.INK, 0.3))
			var gl := Vector2(randf_range(-8, 8), 0) * U if pt < 0.25 else Vector2.ZERO
			G.txt(hud, Vector2(W * 0.5, H * 0.43) + gl, micro.word, int(150 * U * sc), G.WHITE, 0, G.font_title, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, G.INK, 1.0)
			G.txt(hud, Vector2(W * 0.5, H * 0.43) + gl + Vector2(-4 * U, 0), micro.word, int(150 * U * sc), Color(acc, 0.35), 0, G.font_title)
			G.txt(hud, Vector2(W * 0.5, H * 0.43 + 115 * U), micro.hint, int(34 * U), acc, int(5 * U), G.font_bold)
		else:
			G.txt(hud, Vector2(W * 0.5, 62 * U), micro.word, int(58 * U), G.WHITE, 0, G.font_title, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, G.INK, 1.0)
			draw_timer(acc)
		if phase == "result":
			var ok: bool = micro.result > 0
			var k2 := minf(1.0, pt * 6.0)
			var s := "CLEAR" if ok else "FAILED"
			var c := G.LIME if ok else G.RED
			var y := H * 0.5
			hud.draw_rect(Rect2(0, y - 70 * U * k2, W, 140 * U * k2), Color(G.INK, 0.55))
			G.txt(hud, Vector2(W * 0.5, y), s, int(130 * U * (0.7 + 0.3 * k2)), c, 0, G.font_title, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, G.INK, 1.4)
	if paused:
		hud.draw_rect(Rect2(0, 0, W, H), Color(G.INK, 0.75))
		G.txt(hud, Vector2(W * 0.5, H * 0.5 - 150 * U), "PAUSED", int(90 * U), G.YELLOW, 0, G.font_title, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, G.INK, 1.0)
		for b in [b_resume, b_quit]:
			draw_button(b)


func draw_timer(acc: Color) -> void:
	var f := clampf(1.0 - micro.t / micro.dur, 0.0, 1.0)
	var r := Rect2(W * 0.5 - 330 * U, H - 54 * U, 660 * U, 22 * U)
	var n := 24
	var gap := 4.0 * U
	var sw := (r.size.x - gap * (n - 1)) / n
	var lit := int(ceil(f * n))
	var col := acc if f > 0.3 else G.RED
	for k in n:
		var cr := Rect2(r.position.x + k * (sw + gap), r.position.y, sw, r.size.y)
		hud.draw_rect(cr, Color(col, 0.9) if k < lit else Color(1, 1, 1, 0.1))
	var left: float = micro.dur - micro.t
	if left < 3.0 and micro.result == 0:
		G.txt(hud, Vector2(r.end.x + 46 * U, r.get_center().y), str(int(ceil(left))), int(46 * U), G.RED, 0, G.font_title, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, G.INK, 1.0)

const R := 2.6
var opts: Array = []
var drum: Node3D
var theta := 0.0
var spin_from := 0.0
var spin_to := 0.0
var spin_t := 0.0
const SPIN_TIME := 2.8

var pick := 0

	for sx in [-1.0, 1.0]:
		var cap := K.cyl(self, R + 0.5, R + 0.5, 0.5, Vector3(sx * 4.8, 3.0, 0), frame, 6)

	if spinning:
		return
	b_again.visible = false
	done_t = -1.0
	pick = randi() % opts.size()
	var a := pick * TAU / opts.size()
	spin_from = theta
	var base := fposmod(a - theta, TAU)
	spin_to = theta + base + TAU * 4.0
	spin_t = 0.0
	spinning = true
	G.play("charge", 1.4, -6.0)


func update(dt: float) -> void:
	if spinning:
		spin_t += dt
		var f := minf(spin_t / SPIN_TIME, 1.0)
		var e := 1.0 - pow(1.0 - f, 3.0)
		theta = lerpf(spin_from, spin_to, e)
		var face := int(floor(theta / (TAU / opts.size()) + 0.5))
		if face != last_face:

			G.play("tick", 1.0 + (1.0 - f) * 0.6, -4.0)

		if done_t >= 0.0 and k == pick:

	if done_t >= 0.0:
		done_t += dt
		if done_t > 2.0:
			done_t = -100.0
			var o: Array = opts[pick]
			G.main.go(o[1], o[2])

	elif done_t >= 0.0:
		var o: Array = opts[pick]
		var s := 1.0 + sin(minf(done_t * 6.0, PI)) * 0.2
		G.txt(hud, Vector2(W * 0.5, H - 110 * U), o[0] + "!", int(80 * U * s), o[3], 0, G.font_title, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, G.INK, 1.3)

func setup() -> void:
	var today := Time.get_date_string_from_system()
	if str(G.data.get("mday", "")) != today:
		G.data.mday = today
		G.data.mclaims = 0
		G.data.mdone = []

	if deck.is_empty():
		deck = range(LIST.size())
		deck.shuffle()
	cur = deck.pop_back()
	var done_today: Array = G.data.mdone
	var guard := 0
	while cur in done_today and guard < LIST.size():
		if deck.is_empty():
			deck = range(LIST.size())
			deck.shuffle()
		cur = deck.pop_back()
		guard += 1
	state = "card"
	shown_answer = false
	var m: Array = LIST[cur]
	b_answer.visible = m[4] != ""
	b_go.text = "START TIMER" if m[3] > 0 else "I DID IT"

	b_go.visible = true

				last_beep = -1
				b_go.text = "GIVE UP"
				b_go.col = G.RED
				b_skip.visible = false
				G.play("beep")

		"timer":

			b_go.text = "START TIMER"
			b_go.col = G.LIME
			b_skip.visible = true
		"ready":

	var xp_s := "+%d XP" % m[2]
	G.txt(hud, Vector2(r.end.x - 28 * U, head.get_center().y), xp_s, int(30 * U), G.LIME, 0, G.font_title, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT, G.INK, 0.8)
	if m[3] > 0 and state == "card":

		var rr := minf(r.size.y * 0.32, 130 * U)

		G.ring(hud, cc, rr, f, col, 14 * U)
		G.txt(hud, cc, _clock(maxf(0.0, timer_left)) if state == "timer" else "DONE!", int(64 * U), G.WHITE, 0, G.font_title, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, G.INK, 1.0)
		G.mtxt(hud, Vector2(c.x, r.position.y + 100 * U), m[1], int(24 * U), r.size.x - 80 * U, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.8), G.font_body)

		if shown_answer:
			G.mtxt(hud, Vector2(c.x, r.end.y - 70 * U), m[4], int(34 * U), r.size.x - 80 * U, G.YELLOW, G.font_title)
	if state == "done":

		G.mtxt(hud, mr.get_center(), msg, int(26 * U), mr.size.x - 40 * U, Color(1, 1, 1, a), G.font_bold)

	var s := int(ceil(sec))
	return "%d:%02d" % [s / 60, s % 60]

const COLS := [["RED", Color("ff2e4d")], ["BLUE", Color("2e7dff")], ["GREEN", Color("2eff6a")], ["YELLOW", Color("ffd60a")],
	["WHITE", Color("f2f4ff")], ["PURPLE", Color("b05cff")]]

func setup() -> void:

	place_cam(Vector3(0, 4.3, 2.9), Vector3(0, 0.35, -0.2), 52)

	K.box(self, Vector3(4.0, 0.7, 2.2), Vector3(0, 0.35, -0.3), case_m)

	lamp = OmniLight3D.new()
	lamp.light_color = Color("ff2a40")
	lamp.light_energy = 2.0
	lamp.omni_range = 5.0
	lamp.position = Vector3(-1.1, 1.6, -0.75)
	add_child(lamp)
	K.box(self, Vector3(1.6, 0.06, 0.7), Vector3(0.9, 0.74, -0.75), K.mat(Color("050607"), 0.2, 0.3))
	timer_lbl = Label3D.new()
	timer_lbl.font = G.font_title
	timer_lbl.font_size = 64
	timer_lbl.pixel_size = 0.006
	timer_lbl.modulate = Color(1.0, 0.25, 0.3)
	timer_lbl.outline_size = 0
	timer_lbl.position = Vector3(0.9, 0.78, -0.75)
	timer_lbl.rotation.x = -PI / 2
	add_child(timer_lbl)
	# wires across the front
	var n := 2 + lvl
	var picks := range(COLS.size())
	picks.shuffle()
	for i in n:
		var ci: int = picks[i]
		var z := 0.95 - i * 0.32
		var a := Vector3(-1.75, 0.72, z - 0.15)
		var b := Vector3(1.75, 0.72, z - 0.15)
		var pts: Array[Vector3] = []
		for k in 13:
			var f := k / 12.0
			var p := a.lerp(b, f)
			p.y += sin(f * PI) * 0.35 + 0.05
			p.z += 0.35 * sin(f * PI) + sin(f * TAU * 2.0 + i) * 0.04
			pts.append(p)
		var segs: Array = []
		var m := K.mat(COLS[ci][1], 0.1, 0.4, 0.6)
		for k in 12:
			var s := K.cyl(self, 0.055, 0.055, pts[k].distance_to(pts[k + 1]) + 0.02, (pts[k] + pts[k + 1]) * 0.5, m, 8)
			s.look_at_from_position(s.position, pts[k + 1], Vector3.UP)
			s.rotate_object_local(Vector3.RIGHT, PI / 2)
			segs.append(s)
		for e in [a, b]:
			K.box(self, Vector3(0.18, 0.12, 0.18), e, K.mat(Color("8a90a8"), 1.0, 0.25))
		wires.append({ci = ci, pts = pts, segs = segs, cut = false})
	target = randi() % n
	hint = "Cut the %s wire!" % COLS[wires[target].ci][0]


func tick(dt: float) -> void:
	var left := maxf(0.0, dur - t)
	if not done:
		timer_lbl.text = "0:%02d.%d" % [int(left), int(fmod(left, 1.0) * 10.0)]
		var pulse := 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(t * (6.0 + (dur - left) * 4.0))
		core_mat.emission_energy_multiplier = 2.0 + pulse * 5.0
		lamp.light_energy = 1.0 + pulse * 2.0
	if result != 0:
		return


func cut(i: int) -> void:
	var w: Dictionary = wires[i]
	w.cut = true
	(w.segs[6] as Node3D).visible = false
	G.play("snip")
	K.sparks(self, w.pts[6], Color(1, 0.9, 0.5), 14, 4.0, 0.6)
	if i == target:
		done = true
		core_mat.emission = Color("2eff6a")
		core_mat.emission_energy_multiplier = 3.0
		lamp.light_color = Color("2eff6a")
		timer_lbl.modulate = Color(0.3, 1.0, 0.5)
		timer_lbl.text = "SAFE"
		G.play("xp")
		win("DEFUSED!")
	else:
		explode()
		lose("WRONG WIRE!")


func explode() -> void:
	done = true
	boom(Vector3(0, 0.8, -0.3), 2.2, Color("ff6a1a"), Color("2c3036"))
	core.visible = false


func timeout() -> void:
	explode()
	lose("KABOOM!")


func down(p: Vector2, _i: int) -> void:
	if result != 0 or done:
		return
	var best := -1
	var bd := 42.0 * U
	for i in wires.size():
		if wires[i].cut:
			continue
		var pts: Array = wires[i].pts
		for k in pts.size() - 1:
			var a := spos(pts[k])
			var b := spos(pts[k + 1])
			var d := Geometry2D.get_closest_point_to_segment(p, a, b).distance_to(p)
			if d < bd:
				bd = d
				best = i
	if best >= 0:
		cut(best)


func auto(_dt: float) -> void:
	if t > 0.8 and result == 0:
		down(spos(wires[target].pts[6]), 0)


func paint2d(ci: CanvasItem) -> void:
	if result == 0:
		var name: String = COLS[wires[target].ci][0]
		var col: Color = COLS[wires[target].ci][1]
		var r := Rect2(W * 0.5 - 250 * U, H - 170 * U, 500 * U, 76 * U)
		G.chamfer(ci, r, 16 * U, G.PANEL, Color(col, 0.9), 3 * U)
		G.txt(ci, r.get_center(), "CUT THE %s WIRE" % name, int(36 * U), col, 0, G.font_title, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, G.INK, 0.8)

	steam.emitting = holding

		rv += 14.0 * dt
